name: another after story.
source:
A mod for Doki Doki Literature Club.

One story ends and yet another begins. Kindred spirits trapped in every one of us stare longingly at withering pastures.

She whispers, but her words are lost to the wind. No one will mourn for them.

At the end of everything is where you will find it. The gentle, painful, brilliant shade cast by a truth, and the two weary wanderers that lie underneath. Are they happy? Are they suffering? You cannot know until you open what's inside.

[Description sampled from official reddit post:https://www.reddit.com/r/DDLCMods/comments/rmlvif/another_after_story_full_release_912/]
